regions.caption_as_printed: All in Butte and all Irish— sketched from life by Horton
regions.description: A decorative illustrated scene featuring an Irish-themed composition with multiple stylized figures, shamrocks, and festive St. Patrick's Day imagery, drawn in a sketch/cartoon style.
